G=load(); print(sorted(G))

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

G = load()

def find_shapes(grid, color):
    """Find connected components of a given color"""
    shapes = []
    visited = set()
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    
    def dfs(i, j):
        if i < 0 or i >= h or j < 0 or j >= w or grid[i][j] != color or (i,j) in visited:

        visited.add((i,j))
        res = [(i,j)]
        res.extend(dfs(i+1, j))
